row_semantics: Each row represents a specific control command or status signal for the interior ambient lighting system, detailing its direction, sender/provider, receiver/consumer, and associated parameters.

column_semantics.Direction: Indicates whether the signal is an input to or output from the system.
column_semantics.Sender/Provider: The entity responsible for sending or providing the signal, such as CAN/LIN bus, SOA service, or hardware component.
column_semantics.Receiver/Consumer: The entity that receives or consumes the signal, often a controller like RHZCU.
column_semantics.Specified Signal Channel: The specific communication channel used for the signal, e.g., LIN5.
column_semantics.Specified Signal Source: The origin of the signal, typically related to the internal lighting system.

core_outputs.name: AmbtLghtRHRollingCtr_1
core_outputs.description: Outputs a continuous rolling signal (0-255) for ambient light synchronization.

core_outputs.name: UpIPALampOnOff_1
core_outputs.description: Outputs a binary command (0_OFF, 1_ON) to control the ambient lamp's on/off state.

core_outputs.name: UpIPALampColorCmd_1
core_outputs.description: Outputs a color command (0x00_No Request, etc.) to set the ambient lamp's color.

core_outputs.name: UpIPALampBrtnsCmd_1
core_outputs.description: Outputs a brightness command (0x00_No Request, 0x65-0xFF Reserved, etc.) to adjust the ambient lamp's brightness.

core_outputs.name: UpIPALampBrthngCmd_1
core_outputs.description: Outputs a breathing command (0x0_No Request, 0x1_Rate1, etc.) to control the ambient lamp's breathing pattern.
